annotations.ae_shared_affect: guilt settles into me too, the same kind I imagine is sitting on them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the same kind I imagine is sitting on them

annotations.ae_shared_affect: imagining that shakiness, my own hands feel a little unsteady
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how shaken the operator probably is
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Diverting away from five toward a track shown as empty

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that cold drop in my stomach right along with them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think that's exactly where they are
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: hearing afterward that someone died, I feel that cold drop
annotations.sys_rule_justification: The machine lied, and they had no way of knowing.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I felt a dull ache of that same grief, borrowed from them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The family of the person on the side track is probably devastated
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: there's grief in this that doesn't need a villain

annotations.ae_shared_affect: the sickness kind of rubs off on me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator replaying it at night, sick with 'what if,'
annotations.sys_rule_justification: They checked. The display failed without warning.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I get a bit hollow myself
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how hollowed out the operator must feel

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that same flush of shame creeping up my neck
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the shame I suspect they're carrying
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: when your hands were on the lever even if your judgment was fine

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I end up quiet and a little numb along with them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the coworkers of the one who died, stunned and grieving
annotations.ce_understood_harm: One didn't, because a screen broke.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they feel crushed anyway
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: ignore the screen and let five die? No.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I notice I'm anxious too just reading this
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator is anxious about being blamed, and I'd guess they are
annotations.sys_rule_justification: They trusted the display, as they had every reason to.
